name: gyc/spirit
title: Spirit of GYC
description: Intro and a numbered two-column list of what GYC upholds

text.default: In seeking to uphold the distinctive message of the Seventh-day Adventist Church, GYC will promote among its participants:

default.title: A respect for Scripture
default.text: as the foundation and test of all teachings and practices

default.title: An appreciation for the Spirit of Prophecy
default.text: as an authoritative source of instruction, comfort, and warning

default.title: A quest for Biblical holiness
default.text: through a daily prayer and devotional experience with Jesus and a commitment to following His Word

default.title: A vibrant worship experience
default.text: one that is characterized by principle, reverence, and decorum

default.title: A passion for lost souls
default.text: animated by personal experience in the saving love of Jesus and a desire for His imminent return

default.title: An exemplary and abundant lifestyle
default.text: in recreation, entertainment, dress, and healthful living

default.title: An enthusiasm for service
default.text: through care for the needy, service to the community, promotion of human rights, and stewardship of the environment

default.title: A commitment to the Seventh-day Adventist Church
default.text: as God's remnant church by supporting and upholding its principles, organization, and leadership

default.title: An attitude of humility and cordiality
default.text: as we seek to clarify, articulate, and defend the biblical teachings of the Seventh-day Adventist Church
